key_highlights: ASX suffered a steep selloff erasing $169 billion in market capitalisation over the past week as recession probabilities surged.
Australian unemployment jumped to a five-year high, signalling significant labour market deterioration and prompting consensus that RBA rate hikes are finished.
Housing downturn accelerated with Sydney property prices facing steep declines, exacerbating household borrowing constraints and pressure on consumer discretionary spending.
Australian dollar weakened significantly against major currencies, creating headwinds for import-reliant firms while providing competitive relief for USD-denominated miners.

sectors.trend: Under severe margin and bad-debt scrutiny as cumulative rate hikes erode household borrowing capacity, alongside governance headwinds.
sectors.implications: Downside risks to net interest margins (NIM) and rising loan loss provisions for major retail lenders (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Selective strength in gold restarts, critical minerals, and rare earths recovery amid broader commodity and currency volatility.
sectors.implications: AUD weakness provides an earnings cushion for bulk exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX), while gold producers (NST.AX) benefit from safe-haven inflows.

sectors.trend: Structural distress in department stores and discretionary retail highlighted by massive staff cuts, while consumer staple demand shifts with GLP-1 drug adoption.
sectors.implications: Heightened margin compression for discretionary retailers (MYR.AX); defensives like Woolworths (WOW.AX) and Coles (COL.AX) face dietary shifts.

sectors.trend: Severe downturn across residential and commercial property markets driven by aggressive interest rate compounding.
sectors.implications: Cap-rate expansion and revaluation writedowns pose valuation drag on diversified and residential developers (SGP.AX, MGR.AX, DXS.AX).

sectors.trend: East Coast gas market tightness and supply challenges persist alongside delays and cost concerns in major renewable infrastructure.
sectors.implications: Domestic upstream gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) retain solid realised pricing leverage despite rising regulatory attention.

key_themes: Stagflationary backdrop: Rising unemployment, slowing consumer demand, and peak RBA policy transmission.
Sharp asset re-pricing across equities and residential property following consecutive rate hikes.
Currency depreciation cushioning AUD-denominated commodity export earnings while inflating import inflation.
Disruption in consumer spending and workforce dynamics via AI integration and demographic/health trends.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Macroeconomic Recession and Labour Market Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate exposure from cyclical sectors into non-cyclical defensive equities and short-duration fixed income.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating Residential and Commercial Property Downturn
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight major residential mortgage lenders and leveraged A-REITs.
Overweight companies with unhedged USD earnings and international revenue streams.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Severe Contraction in Household Discretionary Spending
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid exposed department stores and specialty retailers; focus on essential services.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate high-grade gold and USD-earning resource producers
opportunities.rationale: Gold provides an effective hedge against local equity volatility, while USD revenues gain from AUD weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight global healthcare leaders with offshore revenues
opportunities.rationale: Offers resilient defensive earnings insulated from domestic retail weakness and boosted by FX tailwinds.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to domestic major retail banks and high-multiple consumer discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: Escalating bad debts, slowing credit growth, and falling consumer spending threaten FY27 earnings.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad ASX market beta using index put options or cash buffers
defensive_moves.rationale: Following the $169B weekly drawdown, broad index momentum remains fragile amid recessionary indicators.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish 1–3 month outlook for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) as earnings downgrades accelerate and mortgage reset headwinds peak.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously optimistic 6–12 month outlook contingent on RBA monetary easing cycle kicking in to stabilise asset valuations.
key_catalysts: Next RBA Board meeting decision and statement on cash rate path
ABS Labour Force release confirming peak unemployment trajectory
Quarterly CPI inflation prints and consumer sentiment index data
China stimulus updates impacting iron ore and base metal demand
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate breaking key technical support levels
CoreLogic capital city home value indices, especially Sydney and Melbourne clearance rates
Bank net interest margins and 90+ day mortgage delinquency rates in upcoming trading updates
Iron ore 62% Fe CFR spot prices and Newcastle thermal coal benchmarks
